description: This file implements WebSocket transport mechanisms and connection handling for the Playwright core client, including classes for JSON pipe and WebSocket transports, and a function to establish WebSocket connections.

classes.name: JsonPipeTransport
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication via a JSON pipe channel.

classes.name: WebSocketTransport
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication directly through the browser's WebSocket API.

methods.name: connectOverWebSocket
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection and returns a Connection object.
